sentences.en: Tom!
Tom!
No one answered.

sentences.ar: الخالة بولي نزلت نظاراتها على أنفها وتطلعت حوالي الأوضة.
sentences.en: Aunt Polly lowered her glasses down her nose and looked around the room.

sentences.ar: وبعدين رفعتها على راسها وتطلعت من فوقها.
sentences.en: And then she pushed them up onto her head and looked out from under them.

sentences.ar: ما كانت بتشوف ولد زغير من خلال النظارات.
sentences.en: She never looked at a small boy through the glasses.
The glasses were for show.
She said: if I catch you, I will...

sentences.ar: وما خلصت الجملة، لأنها كانت منحنية تحت السرير بالمكنسة.
sentences.en: And she did not finish the sentence, because she was bent under the bed with the broom.

sentences.ar: طلعت من تحت السرير قطة بس.
sentences.en: Only a cat came out from under the bed.

sentences.ar: راحت الخالة بولي عالباب، ووقفت بالحديقة، وصرخت: يا توم!
sentences.en: Aunt Polly went to the door, stood in the garden, and shouted: Tom!

sentences.ar: وسمعت صوت وراها، ولفت، ومسكت ولد من قميصه.
sentences.en: And she heard a sound behind her, turned, and caught a boy by his shirt.
She said: here you were!
In the pantry!
And what is that on your mouth?

sentences.ar: قال توم: ما بعرف يا خالتي.
sentences.en: Tom said: I do not know, auntie.
She said: I know.
Jam.
I have said it a hundred times.
And she raised the stick.
Tom said: auntie!
Look behind you!

sentences.ar: لفت الخالة بولي، وبنفس اللحظة، توم نط من فوق السور واختفى.
sentences.en: Aunt Polly turned, and in that same moment, Tom leapt over the fence and vanished.

sentences.ar: وقفت الخالة لحظة، وبعدين ضحكت ضحكة زغيرة.
sentences.en: The aunt stood a moment, and then gave a small laugh.
She said to herself: this boy.

sentences.ar: كل مرة بنفس الحيلة، وكل مرة بتنطلي عليّ.
sentences.en: Every time the same trick, and every time it works on me.

sentences.ar: هو ابن أختي الميتة، وما بقدر أضربه.
sentences.en: He is my dead sister's son, and I cannot beat him.
And I cannot not beat him.

sentences.ar: بكرا السبت، وبخليه يشتغل، وهو بيكره الشغل أكتر من أي إشي.
sentences.en: Tomorrow is Saturday, and I will make him work, and he hates work more than anything.
Tom came home in the evening, late.

sentences.ar: كان تعبان من اللعب، وتيابه وسخة، ووجهه فيه خدش.
sentences.en: He was tired from playing, his clothes dirty, and a scratch on his face.

sentences.ar: أخوه سيد، اللي أصغر منه وأهدى منه، كان قاعد عالطاولة بهدوء.
sentences.en: His brother Sid, who was younger and quieter, was sitting at the table calmly.

sentences.ar: الخالة بولي سألته: توم، الجو كان حار اليوم، صح؟
sentences.en: Aunt Polly asked him: Tom, it was hot today, right?
You did not go swimming?
Tom said: no, auntie.
She touched his shirt.
It was dry.

sentences.ar: بس سيد قال: بس الخيط اللي خيطتي فيه قميصه كان أبيض.
sentences.en: But Sid said: but the thread you sewed his shirt with was white.
And now it is black.

sentences.ar: توم قام، وقال لسيد وهو طالع: بتدفع ثمنها يا سيد.
sentences.en: Tom got up, and said to Sid as he went out: you will pay for this, Sid.
